channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 31
item.description:
27 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Improved deployment of carvable pumpkins, making them placeable more reliably.

Monument & World

  • Fixed collision issues with the large rig monument blocker, allowing proper building and movement around the structure.
  • Added missing vent cages to the large rig monument, restoring intended ventilation components.

Safety & PvP

  • Sleepers are now correctly killed in safezones after a server restart, fixing a regression that let them survive indefinitely.

Deployables

  • Improved deployment of carvable pumpkins, making them placeable more reliably.

Infrastructure

  • Pipe access fixes: trees no longer spawn inside pipes and terrain transitions near pipes are smoother, reducing building interruptions.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Players can now include beach terrain when laying water pipe networks, expanding placement options.
  • Electrical circuits that are modified mid‑tick now update immediately, preventing delayed or missing signal behavior.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 30
item.description:
12 development commits

Audio & Communication

  • Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).

Gameplay & Balance

  • Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 29
item.description:
17 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Explosive ammo now damages monument blockers as intended.

Monuments & World

  • Crates and barrels on both oil rigs now respawn correctly after being looted.

Siege & Vehicles

  • Siege tower doors function properly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam on them.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed a bug where deployable structures could display random skins, ensuring they keep their intended appearance.
